item.title: Rebuilding a chat transcript from a LangGraph checkpoint
item.description: How I rebuilt a reopened chat from the messages the checkpointer already holds, without storing a second copy and without replaying a purchase.

item.title: A join node for parallel tool calls in LangGraph
item.description: Two parallel searches each sent their own cards, so the buyer saw eight items while the model listed three. A join node gave every reply one budget.

item.title: Catching truncated LLM output, even when the JSON still parses
item.description: A model that stops early does not always break your parser. Three checks that catch cut-off extractions, including the ones that come back as valid JSON.

item.title: Bulk indexing when some items fail
item.description: How a Kafka-fed indexer reports success or failure for every catalog item, so a partly failed batch is resent item by item instead of all over again.
